text: What is happening to our intimacy? The guy is 26 and the girl is 24. So, to save a long read, I'm going to try and summarize the problems I have been experiencing the past 2-3 years. Me and my partner have been together 4.5 years. We started out fantastic, best relationship we could ever ask for. Things started to slow down naturally as they do and this is not a problem for me. Fast forward 3 years of decline in intimacy levels and all around eagerness or ambition, if you will, from her side. I have not been touched intimately in over a year, maybe longer from her. It's just at a point of point-blank refusal, nor will she let me be intimate with her. I'm at a point where she will only allow missionary maybe once a month. Wait, but you say you didn't touch for more than a year. So, meaning you're doing missionary and she doesn't touch you and only you're touching her? Maybe once a month and refuses to talk about it. She's now pushing for marriage and the questions are flying in from her family and close friends as to why I am not yet proposing. Any help would be appreciated. I have tried talking to her many, many times and I get fewer results every time. She's not open to try new things or different dynamics. It's left me conflicted, confused and frustrated. However, my partner seems completely unbothered and not bothered that it's playing on my mind. Once again, this story is disturbing on so many levels. You are 26 years old, in your prime, and you've spent three years in a dead bedroom where your girlfriend refuses intimacy, gives you once a month pity sex, only in missionary and flat out refuses to even discuss it. And on top of that, she's pressuring you for marriage while her family is demanding to know why you haven't proposed yet. Let's be crystal clear. People don't change. She's not going to wake up one day and suddenly want you again. If this is how she treats you at 24, it's only going to get worse as time goes on. And you already know that. You've talked to her many, many times and nothing has changed. That's not low drive. That's not stress. That's not just a face. That's her saying, I don't care about your needs, your feelings or your masculinity. And you, you've been sitting there tolerating it for three years. How much more proof do you need that this relationship is dead? What's next? Are you going to wait until she cheats on you right in front of your face before you finally decide it's time to walk away? You are 26. You have your whole life ahead of you. Why are you wasting your best years begging for crumbs of intimacy from a woman who clearly doesn't respect you? This isn't love. This isn't partnership. This is you being used as a provider while she gives you nothing in return. So here's what you need to do. First, stop lying to yourself that this can't be fixed. It can't. Second, end it today. Don't drag it out. Don't wait for the right moment. Rip the band aid off. Third, focus on rebuilding you. Respect yourself by setting standards. Love yourself by refusing to settle for a partner who doesn't desire you. That means hitting the gym, working on your career, expanding your social circle, and yes, meeting new women. Not to fill a void, but to remind yourself that you are a man with options. Because here's the truth. When a woman desires you, she doesn't ration out sex like a prison meal. She wants you, she craves you, and she shoves it. And once you experience that with the right woman, you will look back at these wasted years and ask yourself, why the hell did I tolerate this for so long? So stop being a victim in your own life. Man up, walk away, and start respecting yourself. No sex, no intimacy, no respect, no relationship. Period.
